annotations.title: Code for a web page of meetings

description: Ready-to-paste HTML and JavaScript for a web page that shows meetings near a place, loaded live from the Reachout API (so it stays current), grouped by day, each linked to its source list, with the Reachout credit badge. Use this when someone wants meetings on their website.

fellowship.description: Fellowship codes, e.g. ["AA", "NA", "AL-ANON", "SMART"]; see list_fellowships. Default: all.

heading.description: Optional heading for the list, e.g. "Meetings near Duluth".

min_secular_score.description: Lowest secular score to include: 3 = secular-friendly or better, 5 = listed as secular. Default 0.
